summary: Six of seven checks CONFIRMED, one REFUTED. CONFIRMED: the DCNet record is not the inverted shape it looks like — I read the shipped PDF (sha256 1a87a9…, git blob d36cfb48… = the pinned upstream blob) by text extraction AND page render, and the paper's Table 1 prints exactly six category cells plus ONE 'Total Avg' column, no macro R@10/R@50 columns at all; 27.78 and 53.89 are therefore correctly recorded as WORKBENCH_DERIVED, 40.83 as PAPER_REPORTED, and my own arithmetic ((28.95+23.95+30.44)/3, (56.07+47.30+58.29)/3, mean) reproduces 40.83 and is validated against two other rows of the same table (TIRG -> 27.40, VAL/GloVe -> 35.38). The LIMN record is CONFIRMED as the base row, not LIMN+ (LIMN+ sits one row below at 57.43/78.60), with no printed mean, and it is corroborated by the author's own iteration-0 metric logs at the pinned Hub revision (macro 55.9139/77.8160). The TG-CIR record is CONFIRMED: 51.32/73.09 are the printed FashionIQ-Avg cells and the record is right that the paper prints NO mean. Both PTHA rows are CONFIRMED digit for digit by three independent routes (text, render, arXiv HTML) and both are genuinely printed, with all three reported values simultaneously equal to the macro of the paper's own per-category cells; NO_CHECKPOINT is CONFIRMED by the author Hub/GitHub inventory (zero weight blobs, only a CIRR .pt). What a reader must NOT trust: the CLVC-Net section of legacy_cir_fashioniq_bundle.json. Its 'UNAVAILABLE / no table cell was read / obtain via institutional ACM DL' verdict is REFUTED — the author's own group site hosts the SIGIR'21 camera-ready at https://xuemengsong.github.io/SIGIR_CTI-IR.pdf (HTTP 200, 2859422 B, sha256 4c452584…), and its Table 1 on page 7 (printed 1375) prints the CLVC-Net row 29.85/56.47 | 28.75/54.76 | 33.50/64.00 | Avg 30.70/58.41, with the macro recomputing exactly ((29.85+28.75+33.50)/3 = 30.7000, (56.47+54.76+64.00)/3 = 58.4100) and a derived mean of 44.56. Every bibliographic route the record lists is real and reproducible (OpenAlex closed, Unpaywall closed, S2 CLOSED, ACM 403 Cloudflare, Wayback empty, CORE 429) — but none of them is the route that works, so the record's blocker is a false negative, not a fabricated one. Secondary: all four records set checkpoint_training_noise_pct: 0 where models.yaml records null for unresolved/unobserved artifacts (DCNet, TG-CIR), an inference presented as a property; and the paper's own rounding is not uniformly half-up (PTHA row 2 prints 75.24 for a raw 75.2467). Nothing in these two records fabricates, mislabels, or cross-attributes a number; the failure is a door left shut. All findings are STATIC_AUDIT — no GPU inference was run and no checkpoint was loaded.
verifier: legacy_cir_fashioniq_bundle.json + ptha_mtst_scaleup_mtst.json — independent re-derivation from primary sources (DCNet shipped PDF, arXiv 2309.01366v1, arXiv 2305.09979v1/v2, L.neurIPS… no: arXiv 2504.05316v1, author-hosted SIGIR'21 PDF)
